scenes.title: Out cold
text: You pushed yourself past what your body had left. Sleep, food and drink are the only things that bring your energy back.

extra.text: Basic mode: you'll wake at your last sleep. Anything since then didn't happen.

scenes.title: End of the vertical slice
text: You shoulder your pack and take the road east, away from the sea. Behind you, Skelmed's harbour light comes on.
This is as far as the prototype goes. The next part is the nearest town, the tax collector, and the first big choice.
